title: feat(thoughts): bump pixel blocks to ~13px
body:
## Summary
Chunkier pixelation on the `/thoughts` cards — `OUT_W` 125 → 29 so each baked pixel nearest-neighbor-scales into ~13 CSS px squares at the typical desktop card width.

## Test plan
- [x] `pnpm bake:thoughts` produces 29×36 grayscale webps
- [x] in-browser: visibly chunky 13px blocks per `image-rendering: pixelated`
